body: The KFFM is on the agenda every week.
Every red number has a written plan: situation, cause, correction, follow-up.
notes: Q3 introduced the weekly KFFM review. Check whether it is running.
Whatever is burning on the KFFM today must show up in tomorrow’s priorities. Note each red or yellow function the team wants to move.

notes: Write it on the parking list. The team uses it tomorrow.
